promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文介绍中国民间艺术剪纸的历史与传承困境，以及张奶奶六十年的坚守。
explanation.ruleZh: 被动语态 was taught、have been shown，so that 目的从句，to one's surprise 类固定搭配和名词性物主代词 hers 是本题考点。

evidence.quote: Paper-cutting, one of China's oldest folk arts, has a history of more than 1,500 years
With patient hands like ____ (she), this old art will surely live on

segments.text: Paper-cutting, one of China's oldest folk arts, has a history of more than 1,500 years. In the past, almost every girl in northern China
(teach) how to cut paper, and mothers passed the skill down from generation
generation. During Spring Festival, red paper-cuts with the character 'Xi' or pictures of fish are put on windows
(express) good wishes for the new year. Red is the
(much) popular color because it stands for happiness and luck in Chinese culture. However, fewer and fewer young people are learning the craft today,
worries many older artists. In Hebei Province, a seventy-year-old artist named Mrs. Zhang
(spend) nearly sixty years cutting paper, and her works
(show) in museums both at home and abroad. She now offers free classes every Saturday morning so
more children can get close to the art. 'I want my scissors
(keep) singing,' she says with a laugh. 'Paper is simple, but it carries our history.' With patient hands like
(she), this old art will surely live on for another thousand years.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 主语 every girl 与 teach 是被动关系，In the past 提示过去时，填 was taught。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.explanationZh: from generation to generation 为固定短语，表示“一代接一代”，填 to。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 此处用动词不定式作目的状语，填 to express。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 用括号内副词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: the most popular 表示“最受欢迎的”，三者以上比较用最高级，填 most。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.explanationZh: 非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事并作从句主语，填 which。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: nearly sixty years 与“至今仍在”的语境提示现在完成时，填 has spent。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: works 与 show 是被动关系，强调至今的影响，填 have been shown（或 have been displayed）。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.explanationZh: so that 引导目的状语从句，so 已给出，填 that。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: want sth to do sth 表示“希望某物做某事”，填 to keep。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.clue: 用括号内代词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 介词 like 后比较的对象是“她的手”，用名词性物主代词 hers。
